post.content:
Deadpool digs up Wolverine's skeleton and beats a squad of time cops to death with it. And that's the FIRST scene. 🦴💀

This is Deadpool & Wolverine, DUMBED DOWN: the Avengers job interview, the TVA and Mr. Paradox, the worst Wolverine in the multiverse, the Void, Cassandra Nova, the forgotten heroes, the Deadpool Corps and the ending. Plus way too many cartoon cutaway gags.

New to Marvel? Perfect. You don't need to have watched the old X-Men movies to follow this.
